items.title: Pregnant journalist alleges Rahul Gandhi pushed her during Oct 12 INDIA-bloc march; BJP amplifies, Congress denies
items.summary: Oneindia journalist Richa Parashar, who says she is 3 months pregnant, alleges Rahul Gandhi grabbed her hand and pulled her as she covered the Oct 12 INDIA-bloc march near the Supreme Court; she says she fell on the steps (hurting hand/knees, breaking her phone) and her cameraperson fell on top of her. She was admitted to hospital. BJP leaders Pradeep Bhandari, Rajesh Bhatia and Umang Bajaj visited her in hospital; Bhandari alleged Gandhi 'shoved and pushed her to the ground'. Congress MP Pawan Khera called the claims 'completely false'; Jebi Mather accused the BJP of 'scripting narratives'. Key facts remain unverified.
